learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic properties and applications of natural gas and LPG and the operating principles of their fuel systems.
Explains the functions and operating principles of pipes, valves, regulators, meters, safety devices, and gas-fired appliances used in natural gas and LPG installations.
Performs basic calculations related to pipe sizing, pressure losses, flue cross-sections, and ventilation cross-sections in natural gas installations.
Selects appropriate installation components for building natural gas and LPG systems and applies the basic principles of system design, sizing, and installation.

Evaluates natural gas and LPG systems in terms of safety, energy efficiency, and environmental impacts, and develops appropriate engineering solutions to basic problems encountered in gas installations.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to natural gas and LPG; basic properties, composition, applications, and advantages as fuels
Production, processing, storage, and distribution systems of natural gas and LPG
Combustion characteristics of natural gas and LPG; combustion equations, air requirements, and basic combustion calculations
General structure of building natural gas and LPG installations; installation regulations and basic project design principles
Pipes, fittings, and valves used in natural gas and LPG installations
Regulators, meters, and safety devices; functions, operating principles, and selection
Gas-fired appliances; operating principles and selection criteria for boilers, combi boilers, gas stoves, and other appliances
Pipe sizing and pressure loss calculations in natural gas installations
Design of natural gas installations; preparation of indoor installation plans and basic sizing
Flue systems; types of flues, operating principles, and flue cross-section calculations
Ventilation systems; natural and mechanical ventilation, ventilation requirements, and cross-section calculations
Safety in natural gas and LPG installations; gas leakage, leak detection, emergency procedures, and safety systems
Energy efficiency, environmental impacts, and sustainable natural gas and LPG technologies
Analysis of an example natural gas installation project; selection of system components, basic calculations, and solutions to encountered problems
